svg.title: Coupon lifecycle
svg.desc: A code is entered and checked against the cart. When it takes money off, or the cart is still empty, it is applied (cart.updated, then coupon.applied). When it takes nothing off it is denied (coupon.denied) and the cart does not change. A code applied to an empty cart is checked once the cart is first priced, and denied then if it takes nothing off (coupon.denied, then cart.updated as it comes off). Removing an applied code sends cart.updated, then coupon.removed. Clearing the cart takes every code off with cart.updated only.

g.text: takes money off, or the cart is empty

text.style: fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: Denied once priced, the code comes off the cart: cart.updated
Applied or taken off, a cart with packages is priced again: cart.calculating, cart.calculated
Clearing the cart takes every code off with cart.updated, without coupon.removed

tspan.style: fill: var(--color-rose-500, #e11d48); font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)
